raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "6.6.1"

package:
  name: tornado
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/t/tornado/tornado-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 28e6311402af59c8b02e3fa0f5e7d8eb465b25081381803b127d97e6a4395d5a
  patches:
    # specific to conda-forge CI
    - patches/skip-failing-tests.patch
    # backport https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado/pull/3880 (caught by our CI)
    - patches/3880.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip: match(python, "<3.11")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tornado
        - tornado.platform
        - tornado.test
        - tornado.gen
        - tornado.netutil
      pip_check: true
  # ppc64le emulation is too slow, and causes flakiness
  - if: not ppc64le
    then:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - hypothesis
            # not available
            - if: not riscv64
              then: pycurl
        script:
          env:
            ASYNC_TEST_TIMEOUT: 60
            # avoids time-sensitive tests
            TRAVIS: 1
          content:
            - python -m tornado.test.runtests --verbose

about:
  summary: Tornado is a Python web framework and asynchronous networking library, originally developed at FriendFeed.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: http://www.tornadoweb.org/
  repository: https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jakirkham
    - pelson
    - ocefpaf
    - mgorny
